preconditions.description: Victim (token owner) must have sufficient BNRG token balance to approve and transfer
Contract state must be Unlocked or Restricted (not Locked) to allow transfers
Attacker must be approved as spender by victim

exploit_hint: The approve function is vulnerable to a race condition where a spender can front-run an approval reduction. 1) Victim approves spender for amount X. 2) Victim tries to reduce approval to amount Y (Y < X). 3) Spender front-runs the reduction transaction with transferFrom for amount X. 4) The reduction transaction then sets allowance to Y, but spender already transferred X. 5) Spender can now transfer Y more tokens, effectively getting X+Y tokens instead of max(X,Y). Execute: Monitor mempool for victim's approve transactions, front-run with transferFrom for old allowance, then let new approval go through.
